title: [DDV HOMILY] Is Going to Mass Enough to Be Saved? - fra Stjepan Brčina

reels.title: You Go to Mass Every Day, but Do You Know Jesus?
reels.hook: You receive Communion every day. Does that mean you are saved?
reels.why: Answers directly the question from the episode title and challenges believers who think that going to Mass is enough. Ends with a clear and memorable distinction between knowing about Jesus and knowing Him.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: It is not enough to know about Jesus. It is necessary to know Jesus.

cards.text: You receive Communion every day. Does that mean you are saved?
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
Homily at the Duhovno-duhovite večeri, on the eve of All Saints' Day and All Souls' Day.
Gospel of Luke, chapter 13
It is not enough to know about Jesus. It is necessary to know Jesus.
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?

reels.title: A Grave More Expensive than an Apartment, and Eternal Life?
reels.hook: A grave in Zagreb more expensive than an apartment?
reels.why: A humorous and concrete image that everyone recognizes. Quickly moves to a clear point: caring for a grave does not replace caring for eternal life.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: I have to secure eternal life for myself.

cards.text: A grave in Zagreb more expensive than an apartment?
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
Homily on the eve of All Saints' Day and All Souls' Day, when we visit cemeteries.
A grave more expensive than an apartment
I have to secure eternal life for myself.
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?

reels.title: About the Deceased Only Good, but We Would Bury the Living with a Shovel
reels.hook: About the dead only good. And about the living?
reels.why: Briefly, sharply, and humorously exposes a hypocrisy that everyone recognizes. Features a clear twist and a strong image with a shovel.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: We are not afraid to bury the living. In that, we are experts.

cards.text: About the dead only good. And about the living?
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
Fra Stjepan speaks about homilies at funerals and praising the deceased.
We are not afraid to bury the living. In that, we are experts.
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?

reels.title: Someone Will Bury You, but Only You Care for Your Soul
reels.hook: Someone will take care of your funeral. And for your soul?
reels.why: The roughly humorous image of a cardboard box holds attention, and ends with a serious and personal message about responsibility for one's own soul.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: no one else can jump in to care for your soul except you now, now on earth.

cards.text: Someone will take care of your funeral. And for your soul?
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
Homily on the eve of All Souls' Day about what we truly need to prepare.
they will put you like a cat into a cardboard box
no one else can jump in to care for your soul except you
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?

reels.title: Will Others Be Saved? Jesus Asks – Will You?
reels.hook: You ask whether others will be saved? Jesus asks you.
reels.why: Starts from an everyday question that priests often hear and turns it back onto the viewer. Ends with a provocative question about certainty in one's own salvation.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: Tell me, is it wise and clever to be certain that I am saved?

cards.text: You ask whether others will be saved? Jesus asks you.
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
People often ask priests whether their deceased will be saved.
Who among you will be saved?
is it wise and clever to be certain that I am saved?
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?

reels.title: The Entire Life of Saint Paul in One Word
reels.hook: The entire life of Saint Paul in one word
reels.why: A strong and memorable point: life is a fight for eternal life. Ends with a practical rule: strict toward ourselves, gentle toward others.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: We must be strict toward ourselves, and gentle toward others and direct them toward Jesus.

cards.text: The entire life of Saint Paul in one word
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
Conclusion of the homily on the eve of All Saints' Day about the fight for eternal life.
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
We must be strict toward ourselves, and gentle toward others
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?

reels.title: Do You Possess Things or Do They Possess You?
reels.hook: Do you possess things or do they possess you?
reels.why: A clear and universal insight understandable even to non-believers, with paradoxes that are easily remembered.
reels.speaker: fra Stjepan Brčina
reels.quote: If we cannot give away what we have, then it possesses us, not we it.

cards.text: Do you possess things or do they possess you?
fra Stjepan Brčina, preacher
Homily about the evangelical paradox: in order to live, one must die.
If we cannot give away what we have, then it possesses us, not we it.
If you want to have, you need to give.
Is going to Mass enough to be saved?
